notes: The programme page is a Parcoursup fiche, but for a Moroccan applicant with a Moroccan Baccalauréat the application goes through Études en France / Campus France (see https://www.maroc.campusfrance.org/candidature-en-1ere-annee-but-a-l-universite-iut), not Parcoursup. The tuition fee on the fiche (178 EUR/year) is a general figure; the Campus France Morocco page states differentiated tuition of 2 902 EUR/year for a Licence for a non-EU student, unless the institution exempts the student.
